# VirtualScrollController

> Virtualizes a scrollable list by rendering only visible items, dispatching `ui-virtual-change`.

## Constructor

```ts
new VirtualScrollController(host: HTMLElement, options?: VirtualScrollOptions)
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Required | Description |
|--------|------|----------|-------------|
| `itemHeight` | `number` | no |  |
| `overscan` | `number` | no |  |

## Properties

| Property | Type | Readonly |
|----------|------|----------|
| `start` | `number` | yes |
| `end` | `number` | yes |

## Events Dispatched

| Event | Detail |
|-------|--------|
| `ui-virtual-change` | `{ start, end, totalCount }` |

## Methods

| Method | Parameters | Returns |
|--------|------------|---------|
| `enable()` | `scrollEl: HTMLElement, container: HTMLElement, totalCount: number` | `void` |
| `disable()` | `—` | `void` |
| `updateCount()` | `count: number` | `void` |
| `destroy()` | `—` | `void` |

## Usage

```ts
import { VirtualScrollController } from '@nonoun/native-ui';
const ctrl = new VirtualScrollController(element, { /* options */ });
// In teardown: ctrl.destroy();
```
